ios.desc:
Drop into a live push-up duel: your camera counts your reps, theirs counts theirs. Challenge a friend or get matched with a real opponent at your level, then climb the seasonal league.

PushRank turns your phone into a rep counter and a referee. Put it on the floor, get into plank, and the count starts itself. Full reps only: no lockout, no count. All camera processing happens on your iPhone. Video is never recorded and never leaves your device.

LIVE 1V1 DUELS AGAINST REAL PEOPLE
Every opponent is a real person, matched with you live. Race head to head with both cameras counting and see every rep on the scoreboard within a second. Win and demand a rematch. No bots, no scripted opponents.

WEEKLY LEAGUE, SIX TIERS
Bronze to Champion. Clusters of about 30, top five promoted, bottom five relegated, every Sunday at the same moment worldwide. Your best set places you where you belong on day one.

YOUR APPS, EARNED BACK
Pick the apps that eat your day. They stay locked until today's push-up goal is done, then unlock themselves. Schedules you control, an emergency unlock that always works, and a lock screen that shows the exact price: 27 push-ups left.

COUNTING YOU CAN TRUST
Strict form rules on every rep, checked twice: once by the camera, once by the server. Half reps and phone shakes do not survive. Every set gets a 0-100 form score for depth, body line and tempo.

KEEP SHOWING UP
Daily streaks, 23 badges from your first 10-rep set to 50,000 lifetime reps, a day-by-day activity grid, Home Screen widgets, and every workout saved to Apple Health. Fully localized in 17 languages.

PushRank Pro subscription required; the league, duels and app lock are part of Pro. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.
